subject: Re: Onsite demo next Thursday — travel disruption / hybrid split proposal
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@novumhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@novumhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite demo next Thursday — travel disruption

Marcus —

Quick heads up: a ferry workers strike looks likely to affect travel up our coast next week. Our team that was planning to be on-site for Thursday's demo is getting rerouted through longer ferries and an overnight connection, so several of the engineering leads won't arrive in time for the 10:00 AM slot we booked.

Options on our side: we can try to keep the on-site slot and accept that some folks will join late, or convert Thursday into a hybrid approach (leadership joins live over video, while the local onsite folks run a parallel hands-on session), or push to Friday when everyone's in town. We're leaning away from a full postponement if there's a way to preserve momentum.

Can you share what would be easiest for you and your team to support? Also attaching our facility site map in case room logistics matter.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Director of IT Operations
Novum Health
Attachment: site_map.jpg (image/jpeg)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@novumhealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite demo next Thursday — travel disruption

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the heads up and for the site map. Totally understand wanting to avoid a full postponement. We're happy to pivot to a hybrid plan that preserves a live interaction with leadership and hands-on time for the onsite engineers. My proposed, low-friction approach: 

- Live 30-minute executive briefing via Zoom at the currently scheduled 10:00 AM PT for leadership + stakeholders (concise use-cases, SLAs, high-level walkthrough).
- Asynchronous 40-minute recorded deep-dive that covers the full walkthrough and specific integration points, uploaded right after the live session for the onsite engineers to watch.
- A 45-minute drop-in office-hours window later the same day (2:00–2:45 PM PT) where our SE will be onsite to answer hands-on questions and run through any environment-specific items.

If that works, we can send a calendar invite that includes the Zoom join and a recording release note. I've attached a quick agenda I can adjust (proposed_agenda_v2.pdf).

Alternative dates/times if you want to keep it all in-person: Friday 10:00 AM PT or Monday morning. Otherwise, if you confirm the hybrid plan, Kimberly will be onsite to record + host the office hours.

Quick question for logistics: does the room have A/V that can stream Zoom with stable upstream (or should we ship a hotspot/encoder)?

Would you like me to lock in the hybrid flow now?

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
m: 415-555-0184
Attachment: proposed_agenda_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@novumhealth.com>, Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@novumhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite demo next Thursday — travel disruption

Looping in to confirm I can be onsite Thursday and handle the recording + the office-hours session. A couple logistics notes from our side: 

- I can get to your site by 8:30 AM PT to set up A/V and test the Zoom link; appreciate access to the AV cable or HDMI output if available.
- Prefer the live exec briefing at 10:00 AM PT (short & sharp) but can push to 9:30 AM PT if that makes arrival easier for your on-site engineers.
- I'll capture the deep-dive as a single unlisted recording and upload it to a shared drive within 90 minutes of the live brief. We'll include a short "how-to" README so folks know timestamps for the sections.

If Marcus confirms, I'll reserve the room and bring a 4G hotspot as a fallback. Also drafting the recording-release boilerplate now and will attach.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: recording-release.txt (text/plain)
From: Elena Morales <elena@novumhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@novumhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite demo next Thursday — travel disruption

Thanks, Marcus and Kimberly — that plan sounds perfect and keeps momentum. Let's do the hybrid flow: live executive briefing at 10:00 AM PT Thursday, then the recorded deep-dive and the 2:00 PM office-hours. Tom and I will ensure the AV hookup is available in Conference Room B (we have HDMI and wired ethernet).

Please send the calendar invite with the Zoom link and the recording notice. Also please include the shared drive link once the recording is uploaded so we can circulate to the engineering team who will arrive later.

See you Thursday.

Best,
Elena Morales
Director of IT Operations, Novum Health
